title: Keep lost ownership orphaned without redispatch

steps.title: Prerequisites
steps.body: Build mcp-server and open the demo with bridge, verify and the Editor-only project-command fixture. Use one persistent MCP session. Preserve existing dirty scenes/settings and snapshot only disposable fixture files before mutation.

steps.title: Keep lost ownership orphaned without redispatch
steps.payload: Run the project lost-record adapter and dropped-start transport tests. In a disposable demo session, start long_write during preparation and request script compilation, then observe its original job id. Retry the same key/args once after reconnect.

steps.title: Expected outcomes
items: Lost domain record or ambiguous transport produces orphaned, never false success.
Same key returns original record and does not restart; inspect output before a new key.

reset.note: Wait for terminal execution before restoring saved fixture bytes under Assets/_ValidationSuite/ProjectCommands. Preserve pre-existing files, scene changes and settings. Never restart an uncertain operation for cleanup.
